description: Check one user in YOUR tenant (with your read-only Graph token): account blocked, missing licence or disabled service plan (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Intune), usage location, Intune device compliance and last check-in, and MFA methods registered, as findings with fixes. Needs User.Read.All (Intune and MFA checks need extra read scopes). Token never stored. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

graph_token.description: MCP only: your Microsoft Graph access token (read-only app registration; see https://microsoft.l50automation.com/microsoft/tenant-setup). Over HTTP send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer' header instead. Used once, never stored or logged.

user.description: User sign-in name (user@domain) or object ID
